reviews.reason: The wrapper passes MenuRef through to AntdMenu. The registry-loaded Menu fixture observes a non-null ref and the four original AntD statics; a ref-as-prop migration is not a repair for a broken public ref.

NativeBlockMenuBase is an implementation detail of the exported NativeBlockMenu (Object.assign with AntD statics). The registry supplies that composed object as Menu; the fixture checks Item, SubMenu, ItemGroup and Divider identity and Block popup ownership.
